title: 115 People Vanished. One Word Was Left Behind.
description:
In 1590, John White returned to the Roanoke colony and found it empty. No bodies, no signs of a fight. Just one word carved into a post.

The story of America's oldest unsolved disappearance, what we know for sure, and the leading theories historians still argue about.

#history #mystery #roanoke

scenes.narration: In 1590, a ship reached an English colony in America. Everyone was gone.
About one hundred fifteen men, women and children had lived on Roanoke Island. Governor John White had left three years earlier to get supplies, and war with Spain kept him away.
When he finally returned, the houses had been taken down. There were no bodies and no signs of a battle.
Carved into a post was one word: Croatoan. The name of a nearby island and the friendly tribe living there.
A storm forced White to leave before he could search it. He never came back.
Most historians think the colonists split up and joined local tribes. But no one has ever proved where they went.
